jobs.title: Volunteer & Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Volunteer and Program Coordinator will oversee all volunteer coordination and volunteer training activities at Chrysalis’ Santa Monica office. Duties include onboarding, training, and coordinating all Santa Monica volunteers and providing backup support in the case of volunteer absences. The Volunteer & Program Coordinator will provide direct services to Chrysalis clients, helping them build resumes, practice for job interviews, and will teach Chrysalis’ job readiness classes as needed.

**Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

**Volunteer Recruitment, Coordination, Training, and Engagement**

* Maintain close communication with all DT volunteers and provide direct support on a daily basis, including addressing day-to-day emails, inquiries, and needs.
* Assess program needs, screen, onboard and train new volunteers regularly, and manage existing volunteers.
* Support and/or carry out volunteer appreciation and engagement activities, including recognizing volunteer milestones and helping to plan/execute regular volunteer engagement events.
* Evaluate volunteer performance on an ongoing basis, giving direct feedback, and following up with additional training as needed.
* Work closely with Client Services team, attending weekly staff meetings and maintaining active communication about volunteers and client training activities.
* Handle cross-functional communication and support across all Chrysalis sites, and support staff, clients, and volunteers.
* Take on special projects to help the Volunteer & Program team create and implement new processes and streamline program operations.

**Direct Client Service Delivery**

* Provide one-on-one resume preparation, practice interview services, and helping clients apply to jobs online, as well as facilitate job readiness classes as needed.

**Customer Service and Administration**

* Coordinate volunteer schedules to ensure full coverage of one-on-one and job readiness classes.
* Ensure up-to-date and complete tracking of volunteer activities in Chrysalis data systems.
* Communicate regularly with Development and Communications Department regarding relevant volunteer activity, including a quarterly call.
* Monitor and replenish supplies for all volunteer-related client services.

**Job Skills & Qualifications**

* Bilingual English/Spanish skills highly preferred.
* Highly motivated by Chrysalis’ mission and desire to improve social and economic  
  fabric of our community.
* Teaching/facilitation/training experience highly desired.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and intercultural skills.
* Microsoft Word, typing and internet research proficiency required.
* Excel and PowerPoint proficiency desired.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Prior experience achieving success working under limited supervision.
* Comfortable speaking to crowds and communicating with a wide variety of audiences.
* Ability and willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends.
* Reliable transportation travel to meetings and provide coverage support at other Chrysalis offices

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

**FAIR CHANCE HIRING STATEMENT**

*Chrysalis is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages applications from all qualified individuals who share lived experience with the communities we serve. In particular, Chrysalis welcomes applicants who are formerly incarcerated and/or justice-involved; people who have experienced housing insecurity and/or economic inequity; Black, Indigenous, and people of color; persons with disabilities; ethnic and religious minorities; and members of the LGBTQ+ community.*

jobs.title: Graduate Program Coordinator, Mathematics, Philosophy, and Physics
jobs.description:
The Schmid College of Science and Technology (SCST) seeks a highly motivated individual to coordinate the graduate program in Math, Philosophy and Physics (MPP). SCST embodies Chapman’s mission of providing students with personalized educational experiences by fostering an outstanding community of teacher-scholars across a broad range of undergraduate and graduate programs. The MPP Doctor of Science program recruited the first cohort of students in Fall 2023. By working closely with the program director, leadership, and campus partners, the coordinator will provide administrative support and support a wide range of activities from recruitment through graduation, advising, outreach, orientation, and academic program support. The coordinator implements all activities to ensure enrollment goals are met, engages with students to support their success, and evaluates the continued success of the program. This role requires the individual to be a self-starter and proactive with the ability to coordinate and execute projects both on their own and within a team environment. This position will also collaborate with the existing graduate programs in Schmid College.

Responsibilities

**Recruitment, Admission and Registration Support**

* Serve as liaison to the Office of Graduate Admission, Graduate Financial Aid, Registrar, and Office of the Vice Provost for Graduate Education
* Provide administrative support for annual updates to MPP’s graduate handbook, materials, recruitment and admission
* Support recruitment efforts by proactively seeking out prospective students, track, and addressing all inquiries
* Track application materials and review for completeness, coordinate final reviews with the admissions committee, and communicate admission decisions in coordination with the Office of Graduate Admission
* Provide support for information sessions, conferences, and graduate fairs
* Track and maintain scholarships, tuition support and assistantships; prepare reports and apprise the director of the status
  

  

**Student and program support**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for current students, providing guidance on program policies, procedures, and requirements from admission through graduation; respond to student questions and concerns and refer to campus resources as appropriate
* Monitor student compliance with program requirements and track progression towards degree completion
* Collect data, summarize information, and prepare reports to support accreditation, assessment, program review, and updates to program requirements; monitor R2PC (recruit, retain, progress, complete) data and report to the Office of the Vice Provost for Graduate Education
* Prepare and maintain class schedules, textbook requirements, syllabi, part-time faculty contracts, catalog copy, and handbooks in collaboration with the Program Director
* Coordinate logistics for program events and activities such as orientation, seminars, guest speakers, receptions, and networking opportunities; prepare and process speaker agreements and related contracts
* Partner with the program director, leadership, and campus partners to identify student needs and establish support resources
* Participate and represent Schmid in university committees, programs, and events both on and off campus
* Orient new faculty and students to the program and university
* Coordinate maintenance of accurate student, alumni and faculty records including placement, degree progress, and demographic information
* Monitor program expenditures and provide financial reports to Program Director
* Prepare purchase orders and student expense reimbursements on behalf of the director, students and faculty; ensures compliance with university policy
* Coordinate various communications to students, faculty, Dean’s Office and Chapman community through multiple outlets including Canvas, web, email, print and verbal
  

  
Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution of higher education or equivalent combination of education and experience
* A minimum of two years related work experience in providing administrative, program coordination, or student support
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with students, faculty, staff, and campus partners from different backgrounds
* Writing skills to prepare clear and concise, grammatically correct business correspondence; strong editing and proofreading skills.
* Strong technical skills to learn and use enterprise systems needed to track budget, maintain class schedules, process contracts, and admissions records
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of student records and applying federal and state FERPA and Information Privacy Act regulations
* Ability to prioritize work duties when faced with interruptions, distraction and fluctuating workload.
* Ability to exercise good judgment and accomplish tasks in a timely manner.
* Demonstrated organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and maintain composure and good attitude when multi-tasking.
* Ability to schedule and coordinate logistics for meetings and events including coordinating catering, room reservations and set-up.
* Strong working knowledge in the MS Office Suite
* Ability to problem solve and find creative solutions in a fast-paced, student-centered environment

Desired Qualifications

* Experience working with graduate students in a university degree-oriented program, assessing progress toward a degree, and understanding and knowledge of academia
* Knowledge of graduate degree requirements to develop student academic plans and guide/track graduate students through academic planning
* Knowledge of higher education admissions criteria and ability to develop effective results-oriented recruitment strategies

Special Instructions to Applicants

At Chapman University, we believe collaboration thrives through in-person engagement. This position is fully on campus,

jobs.title: PR and Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION TITLE:** PR and Marketing Coordinator  
**REPORTING TO:** Director of Advancement

Non-Exempt

**GENERAL SUMMARY:** The job of PR and Marketing Coordinator was established to coordinate OCCA's marketing, digital communications, and assist with fundraising and donor relations. This position is distinguished by its schoolwide scope and its combination of creative production, relationship-building, and detailed project management. The Coordinator works across the Lower School and Upper School to gather stories, manage communications channels, protect student privacy, and translate OCCA's mission into clear messaging for families, community partners, donors, media, and the broader public. * Use the donor CRM for routine data entry, tracking, list preparation, and basic reporting while maintaining accurate and confidential records.

**Measurement and Administration**

* Stay current on communications tools, platform changes, digital-marketing practices, school public-relations standards, and developments affecting public charter schools.

**Part-Time | Growth-Oriented | Hybrid**

**Location:** Orange County, CA (Hybrid: Remote + In-Person Support)

**Schedule:** Approximately 20 hours per week to start, with growth potential

**Compensation:** Competitive hourly rate based on experience

About Life Simplified by Shannon

Life Simplified by Shannon is a growing luxury home organization company based in Orange County, California. We help busy individuals and families create beautiful, functional, and thoughtfully organized spaces that simplify everyday life.

Our work is built on exceptional service, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to making life easier for our clients.

As our company continues to grow, we’re strengthening the internal systems, processes, and support that allow our team to operate efficiently and deliver exceptional results.

**Our Core Values**

* **Communication:** Clear, thoughtful, and timely communication.
* **Efficiency:** Organized systems, smart processes, and effective execution.
* **Enthusiasm:** Positive energy, initiative, and pride in our work.
* **Attention to Detail:** Recognizing that small details make a big difference.
* **Integrity:** Taking ownership, following through, and doing what we say we’ll do.

This role is focused on **behind-the-scenes organization and executive support**, rather than client communication or client relationship management.

You’ll be responsible for keeping Shannon’s schedule and priorities organized, maintaining accurate administrative and financial records, supporting employee and contractor onboarding, and ensuring important internal tasks are completed efficiently.

You’ll work alongside our existing operations team, helping maintain the systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

We’re looking for someone who can work independently, anticipate needs, solve problems, and confidently take ownership of responsibilities without constant oversight.

**The ideal candidate doesn’t just complete tasks. They identify what needs to happen next, find solutions, and make sure things get done.**

Provide dependable, proactive support that helps Shannon stay organized, focused, and productive.

* Organize internal meetings, appointments, and important business reminders.

* Help manage competing priorities and keep important projects moving forward.
* Anticipate needs and handle administrative details before they become urgent.
* Protect Shannon’s time by taking ownership of delegated tasks and ensuring consistent follow-through.

**2. Bookkeeping Administration & Financial Tracking**

Maintain organized and accurate financial records to support day-to-day business operations.

* Track employee and contractor hours and accurately allocate time to the appropriate client projects.

* Collect, organize, and categorize receipts, purchases, and business expenses.
* Support bookkeeping administration and expense tracking using QuickBooks or other internal systems.

*This position focuses on bookkeeping support, financial organization, and accurate recordkeeping rather than advanced accounting or financial management.*

* Keep internal records, digital documents, financial files, and shared folders organized and up to date.
* Assist in creating and documenting standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and internal workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce repetitive tasks, and streamline administrative processes.
* Track internal action items, deadlines, and operational responsibilities.
* Research and troubleshoot software, subscriptions, and business tools.

* Coordinate with the operations team to ensure internal administrative information is complete and accessible.

**4. HR & Team Administration**

Support the administrative needs of our growing team of employees and independent contractors.

* Maintain organized employee and contractor files and records.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Inside Sales Representative (Custom Builds)

**The Simple Luxe Builds | Norwalk, CA**  
**Full-time | In-person | Salary + performance bonus**

About The Simple Luxe

The Simple Luxe is a creative services company with two thriving divisions: **Events** and **Builds**. Our tagline says it all: *“we make simple, simply luxurious.”* We transform ordinary gatherings into extraordinary experiences through custom fabrication, event design, and premium installations.

Our Builds division creates **brand activations**, **trade show booths**, **custom furniture**, and **specialty fabrication** for clients nationwide, with a strong base in Los Angeles and Orange County.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a full-time **Inside Sales Representative** to manage a high volume of inbound inquiries while also supporting outbound relationship-building that drives long-term growth. You’ll own the sales process from first response through close, working closely with engineering/design and the shop team to scope projects, create proposals, and win orders.

This role is **salary + quarterly performance bonuses**.

What You’ll Sell

* Brand activations / experiential builds
* Trade show booths and exhibit builds (including installations)
* Custom furniture builds for the event rental industry (bars, backbars, tables, display units, and specialty builds)
* Custom backdrops (collapsible and non-collapsible) and specialty installations

Primary Responsibilities

Sales Development & Revenue Generation

* Respond quickly to inbound inquiries, qualify opportunities, and move deals forward
* Proactively identify and outreach to target accounts (agencies, exhibit houses, event rental groups, brand teams)
* Build and maintain a robust pipeline across Los Angeles/Orange County and select nationwide opportunities
* Run discovery calls and client meetings to confirm scope, budget, timeline, and success criteria
* Create proposals, quotes, and pitch materials tailored to each project
* Present solutions and close deals with a consultative, professional approach
* Attend networking events and industry functions to generate leads

Technical Consultation & Client Management

* Conduct site assessments and technical consultations to understand client needs
* Coordinate with engineering/design to support **3D model development** for client presentations
* Collaborate with design/fabrication teams to ensure client specifications are met
* Provide accurate quotes based on materials, labor, customization, and shipping requirements
* Ensure clean handoff from sales to production (scope clarity, change orders, timelines)

Market Development

* Research and identify high-potential industries and clients (event rental, trade shows, brand activations)
* Build relationships with event planners, rental companies, agencies, and corporate event coordinators
* Develop strategic partnerships with complementary service providers

Qualifications

Experience & Skills

* **3–5 years of B2B sales experience** (events, fabrication, manufacturing, construction, experiential, or related industries strongly preferred)
* Proven ability to manage inbound leads and close custom project work
* Strong written and verbal communication (you’ll be creating proposals and presenting to clients)
* Strong presentation and negotiation skills
* Technical aptitude with the ability to understand fabrication processes, materials, and custom builds
* Organized pipeline management and reliable follow-through

Tools & Technical Requirements

* Proficiency with CRM systems and project management tools (**Monday.com experience a plus**)
* Comfortable with Instagram, email, and multi-channel communication
* Ability to read technical drawings and understand fabrication specifications (preferred)
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel locally for client meetings/networking

Personal Attributes

* Highly driven and self-motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing small business environment
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management abilities

Compensation

* **Base salary: $75,000–$90,000 (DOE)**

**About Chefmaster**

Chefmaster is a trusted leader in professional-quality food coloring, decorating and culinary products, serving distributors, retailers, bakeries, foodservice suppliers and home bakers. With more than 90 years behind us, we are passionate about empowering creativity in the kitchen. As we grow our customer relationships, we are looking for a proactive, results-driven Account Manager to join our team at our Fullerton, CA headquarters.

**Position Overview**

The Account Manager owns a portfolio of smaller, high-touch customer accounts, grows sales with them, and opens new accounts through warm and cold outreach. While a Customer Service Representative responds to what the customer asks for, the Account Manager anticipates what the customer needs. The ideal candidate knows each account's business, spots gaps in its product line, brings forward new products and programs, and works across departments so problems get fixed at the root instead of just closed. This role is based on-site at our Fullerton, CA headquarters.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Account Relationship Ownership**

* Serve as the main point of contact for an assigned group of smaller, high-touch accounts that need frequent, hands-on attention: distributors, retailers, and bakery and foodservice suppliers.
* Build relationships with several people at each account, including buyers, category managers, owners and operations contacts.
* Develop and maintain an account plan for top accounts covering products carried, purchase history, goals and growth opportunities.
* Help systemize how we manage customer accounts: select and roll out a CRM platform, organize account, contact and pipeline data, and train Sales and Customer Service on the new process.
* Keep complete, up-to-date account records, contacts and activity notes.

**Account Growth & Outbound Selling**

* Analyze each account's sales and product mix to find gaps: items, colors, sizes or categories it doesn't carry but should.
* Contact accounts proactively to introduce new products, line extensions, seasonal and holiday programs, promotions and displays.
* Recommend product mix changes backed by sell-through data, category trends and results from similar accounts.
* Prepare quotes, proposals and program offers, and negotiate terms within approved guidelines with support from Finance.
* Spot at-risk or declining accounts early and build a plan to win them back.
* Meet or exceed annual revenue and growth targets for assigned accounts.

**New Business Development**

* Prospect for and cold-call new distributors, retailers, bakeries and foodservice suppliers.
* Follow up on warm leads from trade shows, the website, referrals and brokers.
* Qualify prospects, open new accounts and manage their first orders before bringing them into your account portfolio.
* Build and manage a pipeline of new business against targets.

**Cross-Functional Problem Solving**

* Own customer issues from first report through resolution and follow-up, rather than handing them off.
* Work directly with Operations, Warehouse and Shipping, Quality, Accounting and Credit, Marketing and Product Development to resolve problems and keep them from recurring.
* Spot recurring issues (backorders, shipping errors, label or packaging problems) and recommend process fixes to the responsible department.
* Bring customer feedback, product requests and competitor information back to Marketing and Product Development.
* Partner with Marketing on account-specific promotions, sales materials and launch support.

**Customer Service Escalation & Support**

* Handle complex or sensitive account issues escalated by Customer Service Representatives.
* Work with Finance on order, pricing, credit and return questions that call for judgment or knowledge of the account's history.
* Coordinate large orders, first orders of new items and program orders so they arrive on time and correct.
* Share product and account knowledge with Customer Service so the team can serve assigned accounts well.

**Forecasting & Reporting**

* Provide sales forecasts by account to support inventory and production planning, especially for new items and seasonal programs.
* Track and report on account performance, upcoming opportunities and progress against targets.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Attend trade shows as needed.
* Help onboard accounts handed over from outside sales or brokers.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in inside sales, account management or senior customer service.
* Comfortable with high-volume outbound calling, including cold calls, and with handling rejection.
* Consultative selling skills: asks good questions, builds a recommendation and makes the case for it.
* Earns customers' trust and is seen as a partner, not an order taker.
* Strong analytical skills, using sales and product mix data to find opportunities.
* Takes ownership and follows problems through to resolution across departments.
* Clear, professional written and spoken communication, including presenting to buyers.
* Organized: manages a set of accounts and priorities without close supervision.
* Willing to learn the product line in depth, including technical and how-to-use questions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The following are not required but will be viewed favorably:

* Experience in consumer products, food ingredients or foodservice.
* Experience working with distributors or with wholesale or retail buyers.
* Familiarity with the baking, cake decorating or specialty food channel.

jobs.title: Men’s Social & Community Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

  

The Men’s Social & Community Manager is the person who keeps Buck Mason's men's social channels running every day while standing up events to build community. You'll own the calendar and the posting, write the captions, answer the comments and DMs, run our creator program day to day, produce our events from guest list to teardown, and report back on what's working. The brand team sets the direction. You make it real on social and through our events.

  

It's an executional role with a high bar for taste for someone who’s product obsessed. Every caption, reply, creator pick, and guest list is a judgment call about what Buck Mason sounds and looks like, and we need someone who gets those calls right without a lot of back and forth. You'll work with the brand team and alongside Creative, Retail, Ecommerce, and Customer Experience.

  

### **What You'll Do**

**Social strategy and channel management**

* Own the men's social content calendar across all channels, aligned to product launches, campaigns, store openings, and seasonal moments.
* Help shape channel-by-channel strategy with the brand team: what each platform is for, what we post there, and how often. Then execute it.
* Publish daily, manage the queue, and keep every post on-brand in tone, typography, and image quality.
* Stay on top of platform changes and emerging formats, and propose tests worth running.

**Content and voice**

* Write captions, scripts, replies, and copy in the Buck Mason voice
* Partner with Creative on social-first photo and video, contributing to briefs and shot lists; capture content yourself when the moment calls for it.
* Build repeatable series and formats that give the men's feed a point of view.

**Community**

* Respond to comments and DMs daily in the brand voice, and route product and order issues to Customer Experience with context.
* Track sentiment, recurring questions, and product feedback, and share what you hear with Design, Retail, and Ecommerce weekly.

**Events**

* Produce Buck Mason's men's events end to end.
* Curate the invite list. Know who should be in the room, from loyal customers and local tastemakers to creators and press, and get them there.
* Build the vibe: concept, venue, music, food and drink, run of show, and the details that make it feel like us and not like a brand event.
* Own the logistics: budget, vendors, staffing, RSVPs, and day-of production, so everything goes off without a hitch.
* Capture it for social use in coordination with the Creative team and our event photographer.

**Partnerships and influencers**

* Source and manage day-to-day relationships with creators, stylists, and tastemakers whose audiences match ours: outreach, gifting, scheduling, and content review, with support from the brand team on contracts and budget.
* Coordinate with Paid Media on which organic content and creator assets should be amplified.

**Measurement**

* Own weekly social reporting: reach, engagement, follower growth, community health, and traffic attributed to social.
* Contribute to the monthly brand marketing readout with clear takeaways on what's working, and adjust the calendar accordingly.
* Work toward quarterly goals set with the brand team.

### **What You'll Bring**

* 2–4 years running or supporting social and community for a consumer brand, ideally in menswear, lifestyle, or DTC retail.
* Examples of accounts you've worked on and content you've made, with results you can speak to.
* Excellent writing. You can land a caption in one line and a reply in a sentence, and you know when to say nothing.
* A sharp eye for photography, typography, and taste that fits a brand built on restraint.
* Fluency in Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest, including native creation tools, and working knowledge of social management and listening platforms (e.g. Sprout, Later, Dash Hudson).
* Comfort with data: you can read a dashboard, pull a weekly report, and say in plain terms what the numbers mean.
* Some experience working with creators or influencer partnerships.
* Event experience. You've produced or coordinated brand events, you're calm on the day, and you sweat the details nobody notices until they're wrong.
* Organized and reliable. You can run a calendar, juggle a product launch and a store opening in the same week, and keep the account fed.
* A real interest in menswear: how clothes are made, how they fit, and the men who wear them. You know the difference between a Pima tee and a slub, and you have opinions on both.
* Experience in menswear: you understand the customer face to face.
* Basic photo and video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, Lightroom).

### **Logistics**

* Reports to: VP of Digital
* Location: Buck Mason HQ, Los Angeles — onsite, 5 days/week
* Type: Full-time, exempt

### **Benefits**

Health/Dental/Vision:

* We’ve got you covered – Buck Mason takes care of 80% of the monthly cost for employee-only plans. That 20% not covered gets deducted from your bi-weekly paycheck.
* Dependents – Buck Mason takes care of 50% of the monthly cost and 50% comes out of  
  your bi-weekly paycheck.
* We offer a wide range of PPO and HMO options through Anthem, with Vision and Dental plans  
  through Principal.  
  Plus, we’ve got HSA and FSA options to keep things flexible.
* 401k:  
  We’re all about planning for the future. Buck Mason matches 100% of your first 3% contribution,  
  and 50% of the next 2%. So you get a max match of 4% from us if you chip in 5%. Not too shabby, right?

Other Perks:

* We offer an $80 cell-phone reimbursement for your monthly phone plan (excluding the device)so you can make those important calls on us.
* Every month, you can ask us for a $50 wellness reimbursement. Use it for gym memberships,fitness classes, or mental health expenses – it’s up to you.
* Maternity Leave – 12 weeks of paid leave
* No probationary period to be eligible, State funds first (disability, Paid Family Leave, etc.) Buck Mason covers the remain

### **Description**

SKIMS is a solutions-oriented brand creating the next generation of underwear, loungewear, shapewear, and essentials. We are setting new standards by delivering technically innovative, comfort-driven products with elevated design for everybody.

* General understanding and knowledge of basic drafting skills

jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of **Fast Company's Brands That Matter**and winning a **Best Carbon Footprint**award, we have big goals like being **Climate Positive by 2025**, **Circular by 2030**, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way.Our work has gotten love in **Drapers**and **Sourcing Journal**, and**TIME**wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own**sustainable factory in LA**. We innovate across categories like **accessories**, **swimwear**, and **sleepwear**, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like **this**,**this** and **this**.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that **with you.**

**Work Location/ Schedule:**

* Available to work a minimum of 20 hours per week,
* Available to work a minimum of 3 days per week, weekends included.
* Able to work flexible schedule (days, nights, weekends, & holidays if required to meet the needs of the business).

**Operations Associate:**

As an operations associate at Reformation, your primary role will be to provide support in daily operations, standardize processes in store, merchandising, and maintaining a clean and organized store environment. You will support both the store's goals and your responsibilities will include assisting with inventory control supporting the store's success , while creating a positive shopping experience.

**What You'll Do:**

* Support the operational efforts required to achieve store goals.
* Maintain seamless store operational procedures.
* Consistently use and understand processes and procedures to track in store inventory accurately.
* Track, receive and process all inbound inventory shipments.
* Complete inventory related tasks as necessary with an elevated attention to detail, including inbound and outbound store transfers, shipment, and omni channel order processing.
* Complete shipment processing - receiving, hanging, steaming, tagging (when applicable) and organizing in the back of house.
* Support the process of completing markdowns when applicable.
* Submit facilities tickets to ensure maintenance, presentation and organization.
* Organize store supplies.
* Ensure the back of house reflects the brand and concept standards at all times.
* Prepare and deliver all customer fitting rooms quickly and accurately.
* Prepare and support all customer purchases in alignment with brand standards, preparing, folding and bagging products.
* Replenish the sales floor when products are sold to ensure visual presentations and inventory levels meet brand standards at all times.
* Support execution of visual merchandising tasks as new products are received, including adjusting visual merchandising when products are sold out or sold through.
* Execute visual displays and mannequins when directed.
* Receive extraordinary customer experience feedback and scoring on service evaluation.
* Contribute to Loss Prevention in all areas of the business.
* Uphold time and attendance policy.
* Bring an ambitious and passionate attitude to work daily.
* Help ensure that the store environment is inspiring and our product is easily accessible.
* Understand the core values and culture of Reformation and reflect these in all efforts.
* Maintain and uphold a professional, healthy, and productive work environment.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 1+ years relevant experience in a fastpaced, creative service environment.
* Familiarity with the user functionality of desktop, mobile, tablet and digital technologies.
* Experience working with a sales or retail organization and/or operationally intensive business.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced setting.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively with diverse personalities.
* Driven approach to take on new challenges with the self-motivation for your work and career.

**Compensation:**

At Reformation, we believe in transparency and equity when it comes to compensation. For this role, the anticipated base **hourly range is $16 – $25 per hour**, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal compensation equity.

Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.
* We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees.
* We offer retirement planning support for eligible employees, including the option to invest in Environmental Social Governance-aligned (fancy way to say sustainable) funds.
* We're a mission-based company with offices in LA, NYC and London, as well as a global retail team, which means you'll get to collaborate with people all around the world.
* You'll get access to fertility care support through **Carrot**, and up to a $5,000 USD reimbursement for related fertility expenses after 1 year of employment.
* We care about the causes our employees care about so we donate to community efforts on a yearly basis.
* We offer a clothing discount, culture events (like our annual Ref Values week and Volunteer Time Off), you know, all the meaningful and fun stuff!

***Reformation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The On-site Community Manager is responsible for:

* Review, process and approve all resident notices pertaining to recertification.

* Process annual re-certifications within established timelines.
* Comply with all aspects of Fair Housing and Harassment Awareness training and protocols in performance of all tasks and assignments

* Manage office supply inventory and work closely with Resident Services to ensure maintenance supplies are purchased in a timely manner and in accordance with the approved budget.
* Work cohesively with resident services staff to ensure vacancies turn times are met in accordance with company policy.
* Ensure work orders are processed in Yardi within established timelines.

**FINANCIAL**

* Accurately account for and balance petty cash in accordance with company policies and procedures.
* Prepare deposits for banking and posts resident payments into Yardi within timelines established by management.
* Prepare management required month end reports.
* Manage account receivables and ensure past resident balance due receivables are turned over to collection agencies.
* Keeps resident ledgers accurate and works diligently with accounting to resolve any errors.
* Prepares annual budget

**HUMAN RESOURCES**

* Oversees a min. of 1-3 employees
* Train and be responsible for work performed by all staff members under his/her direction.
* Perform written evaluations of employees.
* Maintain accurate payroll records as required by the company. Review employee timecards on due date as well as commissions and/or bonus incentives; approve for payment within Payroll department deadlines

**CUSTOMER SERVICE**

* Respond to all resident complaints in a timely and professional manner.
* Create a community of caring and excitement that is contagious for our residents and noticeable to the community at large.

**RESIDENT PROGRAMS**

* Designs, implements, and manages appropriate resident programs and is responsible for their on-going success.

**COMMUNITY RELATIONS**

* Manage ongoing positive relationships with all City staff and other local representatives and social service providers.

**GENERAL**

* Must attend Company sponsored events that relate to the development of the team, which, from time to time, may include travel and overnight stays at locations away from the employee’s home.
* Note that other duties outlined in the leasing position and/or assistant manager positions may have to be done by the Community Manager based on the staffing needs and size of the community.
* All references to compliance, affordability, HUD, Tax Credit, tenant selection plans, AFHM plans, etc. are for communities that have some type of affordability covenants that do not apply to market rate communities.
* This position may require the availability to work some nights, weekends and occasional holidays based upon the needs of the community.
* Other duties as requested.

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Current/Previous Section 8 voucher experience
* Minimum of 1 year experience in Tax Credit
* Minimum of 2 years or more in a supervisory role overseeing other employees
* Minimum 2-5 years working in a position with comparable responsibilities
* Minimum of a high school education or equivalent
* YARDI property management accounting software expertise
* Formal instruction/designations such as a Certified Occupancy Specialist
* Financial management
* Proficient in English language in verbal and written communications and in writing reports
* Computer literacy in Outlook, Word, Excel, and the Internet

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS:**

* Excellent customer service skills and ability to be flexible, a team player and interface professionally with all levels of internal and external customers
* The ability to hold the residents and employees accountable without being hostile
* Clear communication both written and oral including diplomacy and discretion
* Must have a strong work ethic and positive attitude
* Ability to work with and understand persons of all ethnic and family backgrounds
* Ability to build external relationships while positively promoting the organization
* Excellent time and project management skills with the ability

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Associate, Direct Marketing
jobs.description:
StubHub is on a mission to redefine the live event experience on a global scale. Whether someone is looking to attend their first event or their hundredth, we're here to delight them all the way from the moment they start looking for a ticket until they step through the gate. The same goes for our sellers. From fans selling a single ticket to the promoters of a worldwide stadium tour, we want StubHub to be the safest, most convenient way to offer a ticket to the millions of fans who browse our platform around the world.

From a team advancing to the playoffs to a major artist announcing a world tour, some of StubHub's most impactful marketing moments require quick decisions, sharp execution, and the ability to act at scale.

We're looking for a **Marketing Operations Associate** to help capitalize on these exciting moments and deliver timely, relevant email and push campaigns that drive fan engagement and business impact.

In this role, you'll own the planning, prioritization, and execution of high-impact event campaigns across sports, music, theater, and comedy. You'll determine which opportunities to act on leveraging insight tooling and coordinate campaigns from concept through launch, either independently or leading design and engineering teammates. You'll balance a planned marketing calendar with real-time opportunities, where speed and sound judgment can make a meaningful difference.

Beyond campaign execution, you'll help shape how our Direct Marketing team operates at scale. You'll identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve campaign quality, and reduce manual effort, partnering with Product, Data, and Engineering to develop tools and automation that make our marketing more efficient and effective.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings strong operational judgment and attention to detail, and is excited to both execute great campaigns and build better ways of working. Your impact will be measured not just by the campaigns you launch, but by how you help automate and scale campaign orchestration workflows.

**Location**: Hybrid (3 days in office/2 days remote) – New York, NY or Century City, CA or Aliso Viejo, CA

**What You'll Do:**

**Campaign Strategy & Execution**

* Own the end-to-end execution of email and push campaigns, from opportunity assessment and prioritization through briefing, production, QA, launch, and performance review.
* Manage the marketing calendar, balancing planned campaigns around major events with high-value opportunities that emerge in real time.
* Identify and prioritize campaign opportunities using event signals, audience relevance, business impact, and timing.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate campaign requests, manage dependencies, and ensure timely, high-quality execution.

**Operational Excellence & Scale**

* Improve campaign workflows, templates, QA processes, and documentation to increase execution speed, consistency, and quality.
* Identify repetitive manual tasks and collaborate with Product, Data, and Engineering to develop existing and new scalable tooling and automation.
* Help transition the team to new processes and tooling. Gather feedback to improve solutions and ensure adoption.

**Measurement & Optimization**

* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve targeting, creative, timing, and execution.
* Partner with the team to propose and execute experiments to improve campaign effectiveness and inform future strategy.

**What You've Done:**

* 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, program management, or a related field.
* Experience managing complex campaign calendars, operational workflows, or cross-functional programs in fast-paced environments.

* Gather departure information for containers and air cargo at ports, terminals, and airports.

* Track ocean containers, rail intermodal units, and air shipments in real time.
* Validate Import of Documentation (IOD) and Proof of Delivery (POD) on a daily basis.
* Respond promptly to shipment exceptions requiring immediate attention (e.g., delays, damages, customs hold).

* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for transload operations (e.g., dwell time, on-time transload, damage rate).
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and work with warehouse teams to implement corrective actions.

5) TL OB OTR Dispatch Management

* Schedule and dispatch Truckload (TL) Outbound (OB) orders using the Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Optimize routing and load consolidation to meet service-level agreements while minimizing transportation costs.

6) Partner & Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.

7) Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

8) Core Competencies

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.
* Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Multitasking: Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to Work Under Pressure: Perform effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**3. Requirements (Basic Qualifications)**

1) Education

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

2) Experience

* Staff : Minimum 2 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Senior :Minimum 6 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Hands-on experience in international Air, Ocean, and OTR freight forwarding operations is required
* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.

3) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures

4) Technical Skills

jobs.title: Facilities Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SALARY RANGE**

$82,000 to $87,000 Annually

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

The Facilities Project Coordinator supports the day-to-day operations of the Building Operations department through coordination of facilities requests, work orders, vendor activities, preventive maintenance workflows, and operational administration. The position serves as a central point of coordination and follow-through, helping ensure facilities activities are organized, tracked, communicated, and completed in a timely and consistent manner.

Working under the supervision of the Senior Project Manager, the Facilities Project Coordinator operates with initiative and appropriate autonomy to manage routine workflows, resolve issues within established procedures, and escalate matters requiring technical, budgetary, compliance, or leadership decisions.

This position supports strategic facility initiatives of the organization anticipated to occur over a two-year period. It is anticipated that employment in this position will continue through approximately fall 2028. The Facilities Project Coordinator role is an at-will position; length of employment will be determined based on project completion dates and schedules.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Work Order & Issue Management**

* Support the coordination of facilities requests alongside Facilities Operations team, ensuring each issue is logged, prioritized, assigned, communicated, and closed with documented follow-through.
* Administer the Angus work order system, including ticket review, assignment coordination, status tracking, reporting, user support, and workflow maintenance.
* Monitor open, overdue, recurring, and unresolved service requests; follow up proactively and escalate safety concerns, delays, or items requiring technical, budgetary, compliance, or leadership decisions.
* Assist the Facilities Operations Manager with scheduling vendors for planned maintenance, urgent service needs, and unplanned repairs.
* Coordinate work orders, vendor activity, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions through completion, confirming that required documentation and closeout information are recorded.
* Communicate service impacts, access needs, project updates, and work status to staff, vendors, and other stakeholders.

**Facility Inspections & Follow-Through**

* Coordinate quarterly facility walkthroughs with preschool site directors, document identified needs, submit work orders, and track completion.
* Coordinate quarterly inspections across all sites with Facilities and Program Support teams, document findings, open and assign work orders, and follow through on corrective actions.

**Tracking, Documentation & Administration**

* Maintain facilities project and request trackers by logging new requests, updating priorities and status, and monitoring work from initiation through completion.
* Maintain organized shared drives so project documentation, communications, vendor records, and closeout materials are current and easy to retrieve.
* Manage routine facilities administration, including vendor records, invoice routing, purchasing support, reporting, and recordkeeping.

**Project & Operational Support**

* Assist with facilities and IT project coordination tasks, including scheduling, documentation, access coordination, status tracking, and follow-up for project managers.
* Coordinate contractor access and support operational readiness activities related to scheduled facilities work.
* Provide coverage for the Facilities Operations Manager during absences to maintain continuity of routine facilities workflows and issue escalation.
* Support facilities, compliance, process-improvement, and special projects as assigned, including documentation and workflow updates.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Two or more years of experience in facilities coordination, workplace operations, office administration, property management, hospitality, or a similar operational support role.
* Experience coordinating maintenance requests, vendors, contractors, or service providers in a complex or high-volume environment.
* Experience using ticketing, work order, or maintenance management systems; Angus experience preferred.
* Highly meticulous with strong file management and record-keeping habits that hold up under a high volume of concurrent work.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, prioritize competing demands, and follow work through completion with limited supervision.
* Ability to process information and communicate clearly and concisely.
* Strong organizational, administrative, communication, and customer Service skills.
* Experience supporting purchasing, invoicing, vendor administration, or operational recordkeeping.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Teams, SharePoint, and Lists.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**  
This position is primarily performed on-site at JCCSF facilities and includes work in office, program, storage, mechanical, and other operational spaces. Occasional remote work may be considered when appropriate for specific tasks and operational requirements.

The position requires regular movement throughout the facility and frequent interaction with staff, vendors, contractors, and members of the Building Operations team. The employee may occasionally encounter noise, dust, active maintenance work, mechanical equipment, and areas with varying temperatures.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**  
Duties include regular walking throughout the facility, standing, sitting, using stairs, accessing storage and operational areas, and performing physical tasks consistent with a facilities coordination position.

The employee must be able to lift and carry items weighing up to twenty pounds. Reasonable accommodation may be provided as appropriate.

**STATUS:** Benefited, non-exempt

**HOURS:** 40 hours per week

**SCHEDULE:** Monday - Friday, general business

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Foundry Robotics is building an AI-native robotics manufacturing company focused on deploying advanced assembly and production capability for leading robotics companies and national-security-critical hardware. Basically, we're building robots that build robots.  
  
We are reimagining manufacturing through advanced robotics. Our mission is to rebuild the American manufacturing industry as an AI-first, assembly-focused, dual-use contract manufacturer. We aim to empower manufacturers with intelligent, efficient, and adaptable robotic systems that redefine productivity and quality. As a senior leader on our manufacturing team, you will have a direct and significant impact on our product, culture, and ultimate success. This role is 100% in-person at our office in Emeryville, CA.

**The Role**
------------

Our conferences and events are currently run by whoever has capacity. That has worked, and it has cost us: no one owns the calendar, no one owns the booth, and no one can say what any of it returned. This role takes all of it.

You will own the event program end to end — which shows we attend, what we bring, who we meet, and what came of it. You will run the logistics yourself, and you will be the person who can answer "was that show worth it?" with numbers rather than impressions.

This is a junior role with real surface area. When the event calendar is quiet, you will spend your time on social and content alongside our Social Media & Brand Voice Lead.

This is an on-site role in Emeryville. Events also mean travel flexibility.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the calendar.** Build and maintain the annual event plan — trade shows, conferences, customer dinners, recruiting events. Make the case for each one before we commit, not after.
* **Own the environment**. Plan and create the booth design, the giveaways and the experience visitors have and the impression they leave with of the Foundry brand, product and company.
* **Run the events.** Manage all aspects of the event from end to end and assign roles as needed (and available). Own the booth build and stocking, shipping and logistics, badges, hotels, travel, collateral, demo hardware, on-site setup and teardown. You are the one who knows where the crate is.
* **Own the numbers.** Define what a show is supposed to return before we go. Track spend, leads captured, meetings booked, pipeline influenced. Publish a readout within a week of every event, including the ones that did not work.
* **Run the follow-up.** Get leads out of the badge scanner and into the hands of the people who can act on them, with context, within 48 hours.
* **Prep the team.** Brief whoever is staffing the booth — talk track, target accounts, who to find, what to say. Make sure engineers who have never worked a show know what good looks like.
* **Support social and content.** Capture the shop floor and the show floor: photos, video, short posts. Draft and schedule content, and keep the content calendar honest.
* **Manage vendors and budget.** Contracts, deadlines, invoices, deposits. Keep the event budget current and flag overruns early.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

Founder mentality: We love people who build like it's their own company. You move fast, take ownership, and find a way through when the path isn't obvious. You have the drive to make big things happen and the judgment to take smart risks along the way. If you prefer a clearly defined lane, a predictable pace, and all the answers before you start, there's nothing wrong with that—but Foundry might not be the right fit.

* 1–3 years running events, field marketing. Conference, agency, hospitality, or ops backgrounds all count.
* Evidence you have shipped something physical to a deadline and had it arrive working.
* Comfort with a spreadsheet: budgets, lead counts, cost per meeting. You should want to know the number, not be handed it.
* Clear, quick writing. Booth copy, a one-pager, a follow-up email, a post.
* Willingness to travel and to work the long day that a show floor actually is.
* A bias toward doing it yourself. We are small; there is no events team behind you yet.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience at a hardware, robotics, manufacturing, or defense company.
* Having run a booth at a large industrial or defense trade show.
* CRM fluency (HubSpot, Salesforce) and lead routing.
* Photo, video, or social editing skills.

We care more about what you have run than where you ran it. If you have organized something ambitious outside of a job, tell us about it.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

This is one of the only places where world-class manufacturing operators, mechanical engineers, robotics researchers, and software engineers sit in the same room — building production systems together.

We are committed to being deeply embedded in the U.S. industrial base. Our focus is simple: build adaptive robotic assembly systems that make American manufacturing scalable, resilient, and competitive again.

If you want to run a mature, well-defined commercial org, this may not be the role.

If you want to build the commercial engine that brings AI-driven manufacturing to every industrial and energy customer in America — this is it.

The base salary range for this full-time position in the location of Emeryville, CA is:

**$90,000—$150,000 USD**

Compensation packages at Foundry Robotics for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position, determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Foundry Robotics employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: Comprehensive health

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

**Why Aircall, Why Now**

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

We are seeking an experienced **Event Operations Lead** to lead the operational planning and delivery of complex, high-priority AMD events. This role will serve as the operational lead for assigned programs, translating established event strategy, audience requirements, and experience objectives into comprehensive operational plans and ensuring successful execution from early planning through onsite delivery and post-event closeout.

The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of autonomy, partnering closely with event portfolio owners, agencies, vendors, and functional teams to manage complex operational requirements, make informed scope and delivery tradeoffs, anticipate and mitigate risk, and deliver programs on time, within budget, and to AMD’s experience standards.

Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it.

Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================

As a Manager on the Commercial Account Management team, you will lead a team of Account Managers who serve as the dedicated, named partners for some of Ramp's fastest growing customers. Your team drives revenue through expansion, renewal and retention across a high-volume book of business, while delivering the white-glove experience of a trusted advisor. You will coach your team to uncover and close multi-product expansion opportunities and help sharpen a proven account management motion as the segment scales.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Commercial Account Managers focused on expansion and retention across a scaled customer portfolio
* Own team-level pipeline, forecasting, and revenue targets — driving accountability through clear metrics and performance frameworks

* Stay close to changes in Ramp's product and go-to-market motion, and translate those shifts into how your team sells, prioritizes, and talks to customers

* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to continuously improve efficiency and advocate for your customers
* Hire and onboard top talent as the team scales

* Background in outbound prospecting, product demonstrations, and hands-on experience with sales tools and processes

* Strong operational rigor — data-driven approach to tracking team performance and identifying coaching opportunities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to represent the team internally and externally

**Overview**

CognifiSense makes VRNT, an FDA-cleared, prescription virtual-reality therapy for chronic low back pain. You will be the person clinicians know. Your job is to get VRNT prescribed: visit pain clinics week after week, demo the headset to physicians and advanced practice providers, keep VRNT top of mind. You will also onboard patients, train our distribution partner's staff, and keep our authorization paperwork current. You report to the CEO and work with a small, experienced team. * HIPAA awareness

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Account Manager -SMB, Growth & Retention (HR Services)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* for employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

* Commission is not guaranteed

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
130,000 - 130,000 USD per year(US)  
125,000 - 125,000 USD per year(US)

jobs.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

**Position Summary:**

The Key Account Manager (Hospital/Pharma) will be responsible for the Sales performance, protocol development and contracting within Key Accounts of the assigned geographic territory through successful execution of Marketing strategies. The role is responsible for developing business plans to grow business through building relationships with key decision makers and influencers including big hospital systems, clinics and specialty pharmacies.

The Key Account Manager will also be responsible for focused customer engagement and sales presentations to specific targets to support to expand the GI Pharma platform. This will be executed through carefully defined messaging strategy, call sequence, leveraging business and value solutions based on evidence and outcome data. This role will also work with appropriate IDN Hospital personnel in regards to transition of care and discharge protocols.  
  

* ***Territory Location***: This territory **includes all of Northern California including the following cities: San Francisco, Sacramento, Fremont, Fresno, Santa Rosa, Palo Alto and Berkley, CA. This role will also cover Reno, Nevada as well.**

  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
  

* Account development and planning through identification of individual account business model and process, including key decision makers, influencers, and protocol; with focus on patient discharge and transition of care process.
* Focus on driving growth among Hospital accounts, GI/Critical Care target and new accounts; Must meet/exceed sales and profit objectives in assigned accounts and territory.
* Educate targeted healthcare providers on the benefits of a novel GI therapy (Vowst) within assigned territory.
* Develop/assess hospital account protocols, infectious disease and GI healthcare environment, and appropriately create and execute the account management and selling process in a manner that is concise, compliant, professional and persuasive; and which addresses a need and leads the customer to action.
* Develop and communicate deep scientific understanding of GI disorders, assigned, and competitive products within the GI marketplace.
* Cultivate and maintain long-term business relationships with key accounts and key opinion leaders within the GI community.
* Develop and implement a territory specific business plan and utilize all available resources to foster a successful sales environment.
* Effectively convey complex clinical and reimbursement product information to key stakeholders in a highly competitive marketplace.
* Execute a customer-centric needs-based selling approach with targeted Healthcare Providers and accounts.
* Utilize the sales reporting systems on a regular basis for call preparation, to record and track sales activity and to gather market intelligence data.
* Organize meetings and deliver content to health care professionals on the topic of GI and nutrition aligned with tangible account objects and metrics as defined by the customer.
* Conduct promotional programs for professional audiences and attend local, regional and national meetings as directed.
* Collaboratively working with internal and external partners in making introductions and connecting to hospital personnel.

  
**Requirements:**  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required; Advanced degree in Nursing, Dietetics, MBA or Pharm.D. is highly preferred.
* 6-7+ years of Pharma Sales experience with demonstrated success of selling Specialty Medical products into Hospitals (Medical Device, Infectious Disease, Rare Disease or GI) required.

• Demonstrated fluency in MS Office (Word/Excel/Outlook/PowerPoint) is required. • Must have excellent communication (oral and written), presentation, organizational and stakeholder management skills (including the ability to develop and maintain strong, cross-functional stakeholder relationships).  

* Willing and able to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Must have current or prior strategic account planning, strong business acumen, as well as strong financial and analytical skills.
* Knowledge of value-based selling and experience with negotiating, clinical influence and account penetration/call planning is required.
* Must be able to work through change management and must be agile.
* Ability to meet or exceed Sales targets and to be data-driven is a must.
* Current or prior experience with data systems such as Power BI, Salesforce, Circana and/or other systems is preferred.
* Willing and able to travel at least 50% or more based on the needs of the team, territory clients or the business required.
