jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Do you want to help run a Y-Combinator-backed AI startup from the inside, reporting to the COO and working directly with the entire leadership team? Do you thrive on creating order, and do you love a role where every day looks different? If you want autonomy, room to run, and a clear path to a Chief of Staff role, all at the cutting edge of AI technology in financial services, then read on!

**Who are we?**
---------------

Veritus was born from a simple belief: the conversations between lenders and their customers deserve better technology. We build AI agents that talk with borrowers by voice, text, email, and chat, from the first loan application through the final payment. Our platform is built for lenders, card issuers, and collection agencies who want to transform their operations with AI. Backed by Y Combinator, Crosslink, and Threshold, our AI agents already handle thousands of conversations every day.

We're looking for an Operations Associate who wants to learn how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it, and are seeking someone who thrives at the intersection of organization, execution, and AI.

**What will the Operations Associate do?**
------------------------------------------

The Operations Associate keeps Veritus running: the San Francisco office, the leadership team's operating cadence, and the cross-functional projects our COO needs done, so that routine work runs on schedule and every important item gets done.

Reporting directly to our COO, Kasia Gora, you will split your time roughly evenly between running our San Francisco office and owning operational projects for the COO. From the Monday leadership meeting to the holiday party, you will manage meeting materials, OKR tracking, vendors and budgets, interview scheduling, new hire setup, team events, and business travel. You'll work with the COO every day and with the whole leadership team, and there is a clear path to Chief of Staff for the right person.

**Who will love this job?**
---------------------------

* You thrive when you can drive high impact across a whole company, and you bring the same care to every task, big or small. You're energized by learning how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it.
* You are relentlessly positive and view yourself as a pillar of company culture, and you get excited by all the possibilities to shape it through your work and interactions.
* You enjoy working in an entrepreneurial, AI-first environment where AI tools are the first thing you reach for.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

**Why Aircall, Why Now**
------------------------

Help turn a trusted telco brand into a recognizable AI voice product, one event at a time. Rare opportunity, big impact: a startup mindset on top of an established, strong foundation. Aircall is a trusted cloud-based phone solution, with over a decade of global reach across tens of thousands of customers. Over the last year, we've built on that foundation and developed an incredible agentic offering, Voice Agents and Messaging Agents, that helps customers accelerate their AI strategy with an end-to-end, omni-channel voice solution. As we move away from inbound paid search, events are one of the main ways we build pipeline and move the brand forward across the US and Canada. This role makes those events happen.

**About the Role**
------------------

Aircall is looking for an experienced Event Coordinator to join our Field Marketing team and run the planning, logistics, and execution behind our events across the US and Canada.

You will be the person who makes events happen: from executive dinners and roadshows to partner events and larger flagship moments. You will work alongside Field Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Partnerships counterparts, as well as Performance Marketing, Creative, and Content, so that every event ties to pipeline and brand goals.

We are looking for someone organized, hands-on, and calm under pressure, who takes pride in events that run smoothly and deliver results.  
This role will be hybrid from either our New York or San Franscisco office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Plan and run events end to end**: coordinate executive dinners, roadshows, partner events, customer events, and larger flagship moments, from first brief to post-event wrap-up.
* **Own the logistics**: manage venues, catering, AV, travel, shipping, signage, and swag, and build run-of-show documents and checklists for every event.
* **Manage vendors and venues**: source, negotiate with, and manage agencies and vendors, and hold them to budget and quality.
* **Track the budget**: monitor spend against each event budget, manage invoices and POs, and flag overruns early.
* **Drive attendance**: manage invitations, registration, and guest lists with Sales, Account Management, and Partnerships so the right accounts are in the room.
* **Be on site**: run events on the ground, including some travel across the US and Canada.
* **Close the loop**: capture attendance and lead data in Salesforce and our marketing automation platform, support timely follow-up with Sales, and report on event results.
* **Work with Creative and Content**: brief event assets, signage, and collateral, and keep event messaging consistent with the brand.
* **Build the playbook**: document processes, templates, and lessons learned so events get easier to run and repeat.
* **Support customer story and partner programs**: help with events that showcase customers and partners.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3 to 5+ years in event coordination, event marketing, or event production, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
* A track record of running events of different sizes, from small executive dinners to large conferences or trade shows.
* Strong vendor and venue management skills, including negotiating quotes and managing contracts.
* Comfort tracking budgets, invoices, and POs against event plans.
* Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several events at once.
* Clear, confident communication with Sales, Account Management, partners, and external vendors.
* Experience with Salesforce and a marketing automation platform such as HubSpot or Marketo. Event platforms such as Cvent, Eventbrite, or Splash are a plus.
* Calm and resourceful on site, with a bias for solving problems quickly.
* Willingness to travel for events (roughly 20-30%, to be confirmed).
* A plus: experience with events in Canada, or a background in AI, voice, CCaaS, or telco.

Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

Competitive salary package & benefits

jobs.title: F & B Purchasing & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The F & B Purchasing & Operations Coordinator supports the Property Chef and Director of Food & Beverage by coordinating daily purchasing, receiving, inventory, and kitchen storage operations. This role ensures that products are ordered according to approved specifications and business needs, deliveries are accurately inspected and recorded, and storage areas remain organized and compliant with food safety standards. The Kitchen Manager works closely with culinary leadership and vendors to maintain product availability, minimize waste, resolve delivery discrepancies, and support food cost controls.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

Inventory/Purchasing:

· Track all invoices for incoming purchased food

· Track price changes on purchased food and report concerns to the chef and F&B Director

· Track waste, transfers, and family meal usage; report concerns to the chef and F&B Director

· Create spreadsheets to track and generate food costs for all venues separately as needed

· Research and facilitate the purchase of new equipment and manage and maintain all warranties

· Maintain positive relationships with all food vendors, equipment & linen supplies, and repair services

· Create and update worksheets to record monthly inventory

· Maintain accurate stock counts, flag shortages and overstock, and complete monthly inventory with culinary leadership.

Operations:

· Coordinate kitchen equipment repairs with repair companies, including research on service contract options.

· Place orders using chef-approved specifications, inventory levels, established pars, and projected business volume.

· Verify quantities, weights, pricing, product quality, delivery temperatures, and expiration dates against orders and invoices.

· Maintain an accurate inventory system by cross-referencing items ordered vs. items received and accurately entering purchase orders in the Birch Street system.

· Reject unacceptable products, document discrepancies, and follow through until credits or replacements are received.

· Notify management team of any receiving-related discrepancies, facilitate request for credit or replacement for damaged or discrepant goods.

· Ensure deliveries are promptly stored, labeled, dated, and rotated; maintain organized refrigerators, freezers, and dry storage.

· Comply with all local Department of Health Regulations regarding Food Handling and Storage

· Facilities Management and Upkeep

· Management of receiving and porter team, creating systems to make these teams more efficient.

· Food product invoice uploading and approval.

· Completes the daily storeroom operations, adhering to established storage, receiving, stock rotation, requisition, sanitation, and security procedures.

· Acts as a liaison between vendors such as pest control, refrigerator, and kitchen equipment repair. Schedules service and maintenance for such things

· Perform other duties as assigned by the Senior Leadership team.

Admin:

· Facilitate collecting recipes to be maintained in a usable recipe database for all venues separately.

· Receiving deliveries

· Entering all F&B invoices into Data Plus

**Qualifications & Requirements**

· Understanding: Ability to read, comprehend, and carry out instructions according to established procedures

· Comprehension: Fluent in the English language

· Organizational Skills: Work efficiently, utilize multitasking, prioritize tasks

jobs.title: Account Manager - NYC
jobs.description:
**About F. Schumacher & Co**

Schumacher & Co. is a fast-growing and innovative interior design company. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. We are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life. It challenges convention. It brings a unique point of view into the world. It sets trends. And it leaves a mark. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company of many brands within our portfolio. This role is part of our floorcovering brand, Patterson Flynn.

Patterson Flynn, the rug and carpet atelier, is the ultimate destination for tantalizing products with irrefutable style, premium decorator staples that are the best of their kind, and unparalleled service that is accountable and unconditional.

Our floorcovering brand **Patterson Flynn** is seeking a highly motivated, professional, design savvy Account Manager for our NYC trade - only showroom. The Account Manager represents Patterson Flynn across a geographic territory, bringing our floor covering to the designers and architects shaping the most interesting projects in the market. This is a road-based role. Most of your week is spent where the work happens, in designers' offices, at job sites, and in client presentations, building the relationships that bring new projects our way. This role will be based in NYC, NJ, Connecticut and the Philadelphia metro area.

Responsibilities

Territory and travel

* Own a defined geographic territory and build a weekly plan that keeps you close to your clients.
* Visit designers, architects and project teams at their offices; attend job sites and installations where the project calls for it.
* Analyze the territory to identify growth opportunities among existing accounts and prospects, and prioritize where your time goes.
* Introduce Patterson Flynn to firms who have not yet worked with us, and reconnect with those we have not seen in a while.

Selling and specification

* Maximize sales across all Patterson Flynn categories, including broadloom, custom rugs, and the labor and installation that goes with them.
* Present collections and line shows in a way that is tailored to each client's work and style. Prepare comprehensive proposals and quotes specific to the project, and see them through to close.
* Maintain current knowledge of product, pricing, lead times, competitors and trends, so clients can rely on what you promise them.
* Work with the showroom and workroom teams on samples, custom specifications and installation scheduling.

Pipeline and reporting

* Keep every quote and order current in our sales system, so pipeline and forecast are accurate at any time.
* Stay in regular contact on open quotes.
* Consistent follow-up is what carries a promising project across the line.
* Report on territory performance, forecast expected closings and invoicing, and bring roadblocks to your manager early.
* Provide the highest standard of service throughout, consistent with our position in the luxury market.

Requirements

Essentials

* Enthusiasm for being out in the territory most days
* Dependable transportation and a clean driving record.
* The independence to shape your own week, and the discipline to make the most of it.
* Confidence introducing yourself to firms who do not yet know us, and genuine enjoyment in building a network.

Sales experience

* A track record of setting ambitious sales goals and reaching them, and of guiding a sale through to close.
* Experience managing multiple accounts and building trusting, mutually successful client relationships.
* Ability to establish and execute a multi-brand account strategy in the interior design market.
* Demonstrated ability to identify growth opportunities, including high-potential customers and new accounts.
* Creative thinking to build account-level sales and develop new business in a rapidly changing environment.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and the ambition to build something of your own within an established brand.

General

* Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with real ownership of your territory and its results.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Windows and Office suite; comfort learning our sales and reporting systems.
* Basic knowledge and proficiency with Instagram and social media.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and adapt to change.

Preferred

* Experience selling to the design trade, ideally in floor covering, textiles or another specified product.
* An existing network of designers and architects in the territory.

jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. JOLT is a global digital out-of-home (DOOH) and electric vehicle charging company, operating across Australia, the UK, Canada, and New Zealand, and now expanding into the United States.

* Analyze performance data and identify upsell opportunities, using AI-assisted analysis to find patterns faster.
* Work with Sellers to uncover new business within existing accounts.
* Support closing incremental revenue opportunities.
* Use platform and market data to highlight trends and actionable insights.
* Prepare post-campaign reports with meaningful narrative and analysis.

### **AI-Enabled Ways of Working**

* Apply AI tools across the account lifecycle, including account and agency research, proposal and media plan drafts, performance summaries, client-ready reporting and follow-ups. Validate AI outputs before they reach clients.
* Build and share repeatable prompts and workflows with the team.

### **Client-Facing Partnership with Sales**

* Act as a visible, trusted point of contact for clients and agencies.
* Partner with Sellers on account plans, pitches and renewals.
* Lead client wrap-up conversations and bring growth ideas into every review.

### **Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work with Marketing to keep pitch materials and case studies up to date.
* Partner with Ops and Product on measurement, pacing and platform issues.
* Give Sales leadership feedback on recurring themes and opportunities.
* Maintain accurate Salesforce activity and pipeline notes.

### **What You Bring**

* 3-5 years of experience in Digital Media or DOOH Account Management, Sales support or a similar client-facing Media role
* Hungry, self-motivated and commercially minded, with a drive to grow revenue and take on more responsibility
* Confident, client-facing communicator who is comfortable joining pitches and meetings with Sellers, clients and agencies

Executive Assistant
===================

**Location**

1 Smith Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201 (on-site five days per week)

**Reports To**

Executive Director & Chief of Staff

**About The HOPE Program**

The HOPE Program (HOPE) empowers New Yorkers to build stronger futures through comprehensive training, employment, career advancement, and lifelong support. For forty years, HOPE has stood as a pillar for individuals facing systemic barriers to economic opportunity.

Our vision of a Home Of Prosperity and Empowerment goes beyond traditional job placement. We prepare participants for meaningful, sustainable careers while working to address systemic challenges in underserved neighborhoods. Through our signature workforce development initiatives and holistic support services, we empower individuals to overcome unemployment, underemployment, and financial instability — creating lasting change for themselves and their communities.

Our employees embody HOPE’s core values—Heart, Opportunity, Purpose-Driven, and Excellence—by embracing a growth mindset, showing empathy, and remaining deeply committed to the individuals we serve. We are committed to breaking the cycles of poverty and exclusion that impact so many in our city.

**Position Summary**

The Executive Assistant is a trusted partner to the Executive Director and senior leadership team. The role keeps leadership organized and moving: managing the Executive Director's calendar and correspondence, preparing for meetings, tracking follow-ups, and supporting board and funder engagement. The Executive Assistant is also a welcoming first point of contact for HOPE: greeting all stakeholders who visit our main site, connecting them to the right people, and managing the main phone line and mail. The Executive Assistant notices what needs to happen, connects the Executive Director's office with teams across HOPE, and takes initiative without waiting to be asked. The role reports to the Executive Director and the Chief of Staff and works closely with the senior leadership team. This is a great opportunity for a motivated recent college graduate who wants to grow in nonprofit leadership, and a strong fit for someone with proven executive or administrative support experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

#### **Executive Director Support**

* Manage the Executive Director's calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination, balancing priorities and protecting time for strategic work.
* Manage the Executive Director's correspondence: sort her inbox and mail, flag urgent items, draft replies, letters, and thank-you notes, and follow each item through to completion.
* Prepare the Executive Director for each day and week with agendas, briefing notes, and background materials.
* Coordinate the Executive Director's external meetings, events, and travel.
* Collect and submit the Executive Director's receipts and expense reports on time.

#### **Senior Leadership Team Support**

* Schedule senior leadership team meetings, prepare agendas, take notes, and track decisions and action items.
* Follow up with leaders on deadlines and action items, and remind owners before items slip.
* Create and maintain trackers, shared calendars, and records for leadership priorities.
* Support senior leaders with scheduling, document preparation, and special projects as needed.

#### **Executive Office Operations**

* Keep the Executive Director's files, documents, and shared drives organized and easy to find.
* Route documents for review, approval, and signature, and track them to completion.
* Serve as a link between the Executive Director's office and staff across departments, so information and requests get to the right place quickly.
* Partner with the Operations team on logistics for leadership meetings, board meetings, and events.
* Coordinate funder visits, site tours, and partner meetings, including scheduling, materials, and follow-up.
* Keep contact lists and records for funders and key partners up to date.

#### **Visitor Welcome, Main Phone Line & Mail**

* Greet all stakeholders who visit HOPE's main site, including participants, board members, funders, partners, and community members, and connect them to the right staff member or resource.
* Manage HOPE's main phone line: answer calls, review voicemail daily, and route messages to the right staff the same day.
* Manage mail for the main site: receive, sort, and distribute incoming mail and packages, and send outgoing mail.
* Prepare for visits from guests of the Executive Director and senior leadership, so each visit runs smoothly.
* Provide backup coverage at the front desk when needed, in coordination with the Operations team.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, executive or administrative support experience, or both. Recent college graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Experience supporting a senior leader, or managing a busy calendar and inbox, is a plus.
* Strong judgment and discretion with confidential information, including board, personnel, and financial matters.
* A self-starting mindset, with a habit of anticipating needs and solving problems before they grow.
* Excellent written communication skills, including drafting professional emails and letters.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities for several leaders.
* A warm, professional presence, in person and on the phone, with participants, board members, funders, and partners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, especially Excel or Sheets. Salesforce experience is a plus; we will train the right candidate.
* Commitment to HOPE's mission of advancing economic mobility through green careers.
* Spanish or another language spoken by HOPE participants is a plus.

**Work Environment**

* This position works on site at HOPE's main office five days per week; the work schedule may occasionally include early morning or evening hours for meetings and events.

jobs.title: Key Account Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Key Account Sales Operations Specialist**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

SANY America is seeking a Key Account Sales Operations Specialist to support its expanding key account business through accurate sales order management, equipment delivery coordination, forecasting, and inventory planning. Working closely with Key Account Managers, Sales Operations, Logistics, Service, Finance, and factory teams, this position helps ensure timely fulfillment of telehandlers and other equipment while delivering a consistent customer experience.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase its market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Sales Order Management**

* Receive, review, and track orders from Key Account Managers; verify pricing, equipment specifications, quantities, delivery requirements, and approved payment terms.

* Compare customer purchase orders with quotations and agreements, resolving discrepancies before processing.

* Enter and maintain orders in applicable systems; communicate inventory availability, production status, lead times, and changes to Key Account Managers.

**Delivery, PDI & Invoicing Coordination**

* Coordinate equipment allocation, pre-delivery inspections (PDI), required modifications, and shipment readiness with internal teams.

* Track delivery schedules, escalate delays affecting customer commitments, and support timely issue resolution.

* Coordinate with Finance on accurate, timely invoicing; maintain purchase orders, approvals, delivery records, and invoices.

**Sales Forecasting & Inventory Planning**

* Consolidate forecasts from Key Account Managers; maintain realistic, expected delivery and invoicing dates.

* Reconcile forecasts against confirmed orders, available inventory, inbound shipments, and factory production schedules.

* Recommend replenishment quantities and configurations based on demand and customer requirements; monitor stock shortages, aging, excess inventory, and turnover.

* Coordinate factory orders and track production schedule changes and estimated arrival dates.

**Key Account Bids & Proposals**

* Coordinate RFP, RFQ, and key account bid responses with the responsible Key Account Manager.

* Maintain requirement checklists, internal owners, document inventories, approval steps, and submission deadlines.

* Gather specifications, delivery commitments, warranty terms, and other inputs from Product, Service, Parts, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders.

* Track clarifications and addenda, coordinate internal reviews and submissions, retain bid records, and transition awarded bids to order processing.

**HQ Coordination, Reporting & Customer Support**

* Serve as a coordination point for factory and headquarters requests involving specifications, production priorities, order changes, and approvals.

* Maintain action trackers and follow up across departments to resolve outstanding matters and improve workflows.

* Prepare regular reports on open orders, delivery status, forecasts, inventory, and outstanding invoicing.

* Provide timely updates to Key Account Managers; proactively flag issues that may affect customer experience.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Two or more years of experience in sales coordination, order management, logistics, inventory control, or a related operational support function.

* Experience maintaining detailed order records, coordinating across departments, and meeting time-sensitive deadlines.

* Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills, with the ability to reconcile, analyze, and communicate operational data.

* Ability to communicate professionally and accurately with internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field.

* Experience in heavy equipment, construction machinery, telehandlers, industrial equipment, or an OEM/dealer environment.

* Familiarity with CRM/ERP systems, sales order processing, inventory planning, and equipment delivery or PDI processes.

* Experience supporting RFP/RFQ responses, multi-department approvals, and coordination with international factory teams.

**SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple orders, deadlines, and stakeholders.

* Strong problem-solving, follow-through, customer service, and cross-functional coordination skills.

* Proficiency in reporting, spreadsheet analysis, forecast reconciliation, and accurate recordkeeping.

* Sound judgment in identifying and escalating delivery, inventory, pricing, and documentation issues.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

**OFFICE + OPERATIONS ENVIRONMENT**

This position primarily operates in an office setting with frequent computer use, meetings, and coordination with sales, logistics, finance, and factory teams. Occasional visits to equipment yards, warehouses, or operational areas may involve walking, standing, outdoor conditions, and exposure to moving equipment. Required safety procedures and personal protective equipment must be followed when applicable. Essential duties may be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle, all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/insurance.

  

**About Our Team**
------------------

At LexisNexis Risk Solutions, we help insurance organizations make smarter, data-driven decisions throughout the policy lifecycle. Our team supports customers by obtaining and managing critical records and documentation that contribute to accurate risk assessment and operational efficiency. As part of a collaborative, fast-paced production environment, we work closely with internal partners, law enforcement agencies, and other external resources to deliver high-quality results that help our customers reduce risk and improve outcomes. We are committed to accuracy, teamwork, and exceptional service, creating an environment where employees can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact every day.

  
  

**About the Role**

As a Records Acquisition Specialist, you will support insurance customers by researching, obtaining, and maintaining police records and related documentation. You will work with internal and external resources, including law enforcement agencies, to help ensure records are accurate, complete, and delivered in accordance with company standards. This role is onsite five days per week and offers the opportunity to contribute to a collaborative, production-focused environment.

* Research and review requests and police records information from websites and various internal and external databases.
* Fulfill, edit, and modify requests for police records to ensure compliance with company standards and completeness of orders for product delivery.
* Perform additional research as required to meet customer expectations.
* Meet and exceed established departmental goals for productivity and accuracy.
* Conduct outgoing calls to agencies regarding requests.
* Review, compile, acquire, organize, and maintain records.
* Apply an understanding of records procurement processes for insurance purposes.
Support the delivery of high-quality customer outcomes through accurate record management.  

  

**Requirements**

* Customer service skills with a focus on creating, maintaining, and enhancing customer relationships.
* Experience in Criminal Justice, Insurance Claims, Call Center environments, and/or police departments. (Preferred not required)
* Ability to use Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Ability to learn quickly and thrive in a production-based environment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* High school diploma required.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer service and support.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant provides comprehensive administrative, operational, and project support to the Demand Generation Leadership Team (DGLT). This role serves as a trusted partner to the leadership team by managing complex priorities, coordinating executive communications, facilitating key business rhythms, and ensuring effective execution of strategic and operational initiatives.

The position requires exceptional organizational skills, strong business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to successfully support multiple senior leaders in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is highly proactive, detail-oriented, and able to manage competing priorities with professionalism, a high degree of discretion, and accountability.

**Responsibilities**:

**Leadership Team Support**

* Provide executive-level administrative support to the Demand Generation Leadership Team (DGLT), including the SVP and designated Vice Presidents.
* Manage complex, multi-leader calendars, balancing competing priorities and scheduling demands.
* Coordinate executive communications with a high degree of discretion and confidentiality.
* Serve as a key liaison between leadership, internal partners, and external stakeholders.
* Anticipate leadership needs and proactively identify solutions to scheduling, communication, and operational challenges.
* Ensure leader priorities, commitments, and follow-up actions are effectively managed and completed.
* Enable alignment and coordination across leaders and teams.

**Meeting & Event Coordination**

* Plan and execute leadership meetings, offsites, and business reviews.
* Coordinate agendas, logistics, and supporting materials.
* Prepare pre-read materials, reports, and briefing documents.
* Track action items, decisions, and follow-up activities to ensure timely completion.
* Manage meeting logistics, including conference rooms, catering, technology, and attendee communications.

**Travel & Expense Management**

* Coordinate travel arrangements for leadership team members in alignment with company policy
* Prepare and submit expense reports accurately and timely

**Office & Operational Management**

* Maintain office equipment and supplies; oversee updates to business cards and stationery
* Process and track vendor invoices; support department budget tracking in partnership with Finance and Procurement
* Manage jet tracking and related documentation for Finance and Tax/Audit requirements
* Maintain shared drives and document repositories to ensure materials are current, organized, and accessible

**Strategic & Project Support**

* Conduct research, prepare briefing documents, and summarize insights to support Demand Generation strategic initiatives.
* Track and report on key projects, priorities, and deliverables to ensure alignment with leadership objectives.
* Prepare executive presentations, reports, and business review materials.
* Support executive communications and presentation development for internal and external audiences.
* Coordinate leadership operating rhythms, including staff meetings, planning sessions, and business reviews.

**Team Engagement & Culture**

* Coordinate department-wide activities, celebrations, and offsites to foster team morale and cohesion
* Support internal communications and drive participation in culture-building initiatives
* Help reinforce a collaborative, high-performing leadership team environment

**Requirements:**

* 4 Year Degree
* ***Minimum***: 5+ years of Executive Assistant or senior administrative support experience.
* Experience supporting Vice Presidents, Senior Vice Presidents, or other executive-level leaders in a fast-paced corporate environment.
* ***Preferred***: Experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously.
* Experience coordinating executive meetings, offsites, and strategic initiatives.

**About Wolf Electric Supply Company**

Wolf Electric Supply Company is an electrical wholesale distributor that supplies electrical contractors with lighting, switchgear, wire, conduit, and other electrical materials for commercial and industrial construction projects. Established in 1986, the company serves the Chicagoland region and supports projects of varying sizes through product sourcing, material procurement, quotations, and delivery coordination.

With access to more than 100 product lines, Wolf Electric Supply helps electrical contractors obtain the materials they need to keep construction projects moving efficiently. Its additional services include fixture storage, wire reeling, and used lighting recycling. The company combines electrical product expertise with personalized service to support contractors, project teams, and construction-related businesses. Wolf Electric Supply Co.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Electrical Project Coordinator to support the coordination of electrical materials, project orders, supplier communications, and delivery schedules. This position is suited to an organized professional with experience or an interest in construction coordination, electrical distribution, purchasing, order management, or project administration.

The successful candidate will help ensure that electrical materials are accurately quoted, properly tracked, and coordinated with customer requirements and project schedules.

**Job Summary**

Wolf Electric Supply Company is seeking an Electrical Project Coordinator to support the coordination of electrical supply requirements for commercial and industrial construction projects.

This position will help manage project-related material requests, quotations, purchase orders, product availability, order status updates, and delivery schedules. Working with inside sales, outside sales, purchasing, warehouse personnel, suppliers, and electrical contractors, the coordinator will help ensure that project materials are processed accurately and delivered according to established timelines.

The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, effective communication, and the ability to manage multiple project orders simultaneously. * Join Wolf Electric Supply Company and build your career in the electrical distribution and construction supply industry. You will gain practical experience coordinating electrical materials, supporting contractor requirements, tracking project orders, and helping commercial and industrial construction projects stay on schedule.
* Work alongside sales, purchasing, warehouse, and supplier teams to understand how electrical products move from procurement through order fulfilment and delivery. **Summary:**  
Equal Hope is a non-profit sitting on the Rush University Medical Center Campus (Sankofa Wellness Village) dedicated to eliminating health inequities, particularly in cancer care. The organization focuses on providing free breast and cervical cancer services to uninsured and underinsured individuals. Through research, advocacy, education, and patient navigation, Equal Hope strives to create sustainable health outcomes and true health equity. Equal Care is a project of Equal Hope. Equal Care believes that inadequate access to quality health care drives many healthcare disparities. To Equal Hope, equal care means providing solutions and improvements that make care accessible to all.

**Other information:**  

* 5+ experience in community health, public health, health education, health promotion, public outreach, and community engaged research
* Bachelors degree or higher in Public Health, Community Health, or a related field
* Ability to understand data, design, implement, and evaluate health promotion programs that address community needs
* Experience in the field of breast or gynecological cancer would be useful though not necessary

  
**Preferred Job Qualifications:**  

* Masters of Public Health
* Experience working in or with hospital systems, academic medical centers, community health centers, or health-focused coalitions.

  
**Physical Demands:**  
N/A
  
  
**Competencies:**  

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent health promotion, public outreach, and community partnership building skills.

This can include knowledge of program operation, monitoring, and evaluation. Stays current in the field and is knowledgeable concerning new developments. Invests in efforts to maintain and enhance professional competence and applies knowledge obtained in development of policies/procedures.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, and PowerPoint necessary.
* Experience working with Canva, Kahoot, Slido.

Willing to travel as needed.

**About Cross Street:**

Cross Street is a Chicago-based real estate services firm built on a strong foundation of property operations and client service. We bring together institutional-level experience with an entrepreneurial mindset to support owners and investors across residential portfolios.

From property management to brokerage and advisory, our team takes a hands-on, accountable approach focused on long-term value for both our clients and the residents who call these community’s home.

**Job Overview:**

The Property Content Coordinator brings Cross Street properties to life through hands-on content creation, community outreach, events, and day-to-day marketing execution. This active, property-facing role regularly spends time on-site and in surrounding neighborhoods—capturing photos and videos, connecting with local businesses and community partners, supporting events, and collaborating with leasing teams.

The Coordinator supports leasing momentum during lease-up and ongoing occupancy by ensuring each property has timely, engaging content and consistent marketing support throughout its lifecycle. Working closely with the Senior Property Marketing Manager and broader marketing team, the Coordinator also maintains asset libraries and content calendars, coordinates photography and videography vendors, and tracks marketing projects, approvals, and deliverables.

* Support marketing budget tracking by collecting quotes, coordinating invoice processing with vendors and accounting, and maintaining cost, approval, and expense records.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
Globetrotters Engineering is a full-service professional organization based in beautiful downtown Chicago, with remote work opportunities to work in downstate Illinois and Tampa, Florida area. We are proud to have served the public and private sectors since 1974, drawing upon highly qualified and experienced staff with diverse expertise to provide cost-effective, sustainable, and responsive services to our clients. Globetrotters is committed to planning, designing, constructing, and managing quality and sustainable infrastructure projects that play an integral role in the development and success of the communities we serve.

Globetrotters is a three-time honoree of the Best & Brightest Company to Work For® award (2024, 2025, 2026) and was also recognized as one of the Best Companies to Work for in Engineering in 2025. These distinguished awards recognize organizations that foster exceptional workplace cultures and demonstrate innovative business practices.

**Position Summary:**

Our onsite Program Management team in Chicago, IL is looking to add a driven and collaborative Assistant Project Manager - BHS in support of a multi-billion-dollar airport capital Redevelopment Program at O’Hare International Airport. This position allows for the opportunity to be a major contributor to the growth of one of the busiest airports in the world as part of the program management team.

Reporting to the Baggage Handling System (BHS) Project Manager, the Assistant Project Manager will support the planning, coordination, and execution of complex baggage handling system projects at O'Hare International Airport. This role serves as a key liaison between the Chicago Department of Aviation (CDA), client representatives, consultants, and the appointed Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) to help ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards.

The Assistant Project Manager will support the Project Manager in stakeholder coordination, interface management, design and construction oversight, value engineering, risk management, problem resolution, reporting, and the preparation of presentations and project documentation. The role also provides day-to-day technical and administrative support throughout all phases of project delivery.

Responsibilities include assisting with the development of project plans, contract packages, procurement documents, and project execution strategies; providing technical support during design and construction; and coordinating project activities with internal and external stakeholders. The Assistant Project Manager will conduct regular site inspections to monitor construction progress, facilitate the Request for Information (RFI) and submittal review processes, assist in evaluating proposed design changes, and support the technical review of design and construction documents for compliance with project requirements.

Additional responsibilities include monitoring project schedules, tracking the CMAR's required reporting and contractual compliance, participating in project meetings and technical workshops, documenting action items, and supporting issue resolution. In the absence of the Project Manager, the Assistant Project Manager may serve as the acting Project Manager, providing leadership and ensuring continuity of project operations.

**We are looking for someone who has:**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, required.
* Minimum of five (5) years of experience as an Assistant Project Manager within an engineering, environmental, construction, or related professional services organization.
* Experience supporting the design and construction of projects with a minimum construction value of $100 million.
* Demonstrated project management experience throughout the design and construction phases of vertical building projects.
* Working knowledge of pre-design and pre-construction processes, building systems and technologies, contract administration, project delivery methods, team leadership, and client relationship management.
* Experience managing or supporting vertical design and construction projects.
* Ability to work onsite full-time at O'Hare International Airport as part of the Program Management Team.
* Experience with airline data systems, building management systems (BMS), and mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection (MEPFP) systems.
* Experience utilizing Building Information Modeling (BIM) for project coordination and delivery.
* Experience working on aviation design or construction management projects.
* Experience with alternative project delivery methods, including Design-Build, CMAR, or Progressive Design-Build.
* Professional certification or licensure is preferred, including one or more of the following: Project Management Professional (PMP), Design-Build Institute of America (DBIA) Professional™, Professional Engineer (PE), or Registered Architect (RA).
* **Ability to work onsite full time at O’Hare International Airport with the program management team**

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.*

*The base salary range for this position is $105,000 – 145,000. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on factors, including but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.*

MAC Faucets designs and manufactures automatic faucets, soap dispensers, flush valves, and matching restroom accessories. We are seeking an experienced sales representative to introduce our revolutionary EvrLast™ electronic flush valve to commercial plumbing customers and grow our distribution network.

EvrLast features a replaceable cartridge containing the valving system, electronics, and batteries. This design simplifies maintenance without shutting off the water, helping reduce labor and restroom downtime.

This position combines work at our Paramount office with regular visits to plumbing showrooms, distributors, wholesalers, contractors, and commercial facilities.

Your primary goal will be to get in front of purchasing decision-makers, demonstrate EvrLast, explain its advantages, and secure stocking commitments, product placements, and sales. **Required Qualifications**

* At least two years selling commercial plumbing fixtures, restroom equipment, or closely related products.
* Proven success opening accounts and generating new business.
* Experience presenting products to distributors, wholesalers, showrooms, or commercial customers.

* Willingness to travel regularly throughout an assigned territory.

Submit your resume and a brief summary of your relevant sales experience. Include the products you have sold, your experience visiting distributors and showrooms, and examples of new accounts you have developed.

new_jobs.title: Event/Field Marketing Manager
new_jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
new_jobs.description:
**About Arena Intelligence**
============================

Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it.

Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do.

We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus.

**About the Role**
------------------

Arena is looking for an Event/Field Marketing Manager to bring Arena to life in person. Our community of millions is mostly online, and the people who rely on our evaluations (AI researchers, developers, creative professionals, and the teams at leading labs and enterprises) gather at a handful of events each year. In this role, you will own how Arena shows up in those rooms and create new ones of our own, from community meetups in the Bay Area to a major presence at the industry’s biggest conferences.

As a key member of the growing Marketing team, you will work closely with Product Marketing, Community, Research, Comms, and Partnerships. Your work will turn Arena’s credibility online into relationships offline: new users who become regular voters, researchers who trust our methodology, and enterprise and lab contacts who become customers and partners.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in San Francisco and the greater Bay Area. You will plan, run, and measure events end to end, while preserving the scientific rigor, transparency, and community-first spirit Arena is known for. We believe evaluation should be grounded in real usage and shaped by the people who rely on AI every day. This role is for someone who can turn that belief into events and field programs people remember and talk about.

---------------

Veritus was born from a simple belief: the conversations between lenders and their customers deserve better technology. **COME FOR THE JOB-STAY FOR THE CAREER! INSIDE SALES REPRESENTATIVE! THIS IS A FULL-TIME PERMANENT POSITION THAT IS LOCATED IN MARIETTA, GA!**
  
  
FCX Performance is an Applied Industrial Technologies Company and a leading process flow control company. As an Inbound-Inside Sales Representative with FCX Performance/Eads, you will establish and expand relationships with current customers and our outside sales team. You’ll spend your time interacting with your customers in determining their process flow control needs, while providing solutions to meet those needs. You will have a direct impact on customer satisfaction, retention and sales results!

In addition to competitive pay and all the benefits you’d expect from an industry leader (**401K with company match, insurance, time off, employee assistance, tuition reimbursement, etc**.) you will also enjoy:

* **A LASTING CAREER** – Career paths are available in sales, management, and operations throughout the country
* Professional development and training
* Team oriented company culture where it’s called work for a reason but have fun in the process
* Join a local team with company backing

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities:**

* Sell company products and services to customers by processing orders, price and delivery inquiries, providing technical and application information, soliciting customer orders and suggesting additional products in a fast paced multi-tasking environment.
* Maintains responsibility of orders from quotation to collection:
  + Select and specify a variety of products utilizing a variety of FCX and vendor supplied tools/software.
  + Responds to customer inquiries.
  + Processes customers’ orders and send order acknowledgements.
    - Review customer purchase orders for special conditions/documentation
  + Checks availability and verifies ship dates.
  + Increases order size by suggesting related items, explaining features, and checking customer’s buying history.
* Processes and expedites orders, customer returns and returns to vendors in an accurate and timely manner. Locates product and creates purchase orders. Follows-up with vendors to ensure timely delivery.
* Negotiates pricing and delivery with vendors when necessary.
* Works closely with Outside Salesman in soliciting business, executing order transactions and maintaining superior customer service levels.
* Communicates effectively and participates positively as a member of the Branch/Division inside sales team (e.g. sharing work load when possible, picking incoming phone calls, etc.)
* Maximizes gross margin by ensuring that FCX gets paid for superior service, problem solving, and technical expertise.
* Reviews open customer order reports and takes action on open items; specifically, those items that may be at risk in meeting the customer’s promised delivery date.
* Other duties as assigned by Management.

**Preferred Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree **preferred**.
* 1-3+ years’ experience in Customer Service related Industry preferred, experience in an Inside Technical Sales/Customer Service role with an Industrial Distributor a plus.

#LI-LG1 #LI-ONSITE

Founded in 1923, Applied Industrial Technologies (NYSE: AIT) is a leading value-added distributor and technical solutions provider of industrial motion, fluid power, flow control, automation technologies, and related maintenance supplies. Our leading brands, specialized services, and comprehensive knowledge serve MRO and OEM end users in virtually all industrial markets through our multi-channel capabilities that provide choice, convenience, and expertise.

**Applied Industrial Technologies is built on a philosophy that puts people first. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a workforce in which we enforce fair treatment and provide growth opportunities for everyone. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.**

new_jobs.title: Service Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
Gwinnett Place Nissan is seeking a motivated and customer-focused Service Business Development Representative to join our team in Duluth, GA. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for our service customers, driving customer engagement and promoting our dealership’s service offerings. You will play a key role in maintaining strong client relationships and ensuring a positive service experience, contributing to the overall growth and success of our service department.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Contact existing and prospective customers to schedule service appointments and promote service specials.
* Follow up on service recommendations and recalls to increase customer retention and satisfaction.
* Maintain accurate and organized records of customer interactions and service appointments in the dealership’s CRM system.
* Collaborate with service advisors and technicians to provide timely updates and ensure excellent customer service.
* Proactively identify opportunities to increase service department sales and customer loyalty.

**Requirements**
----------------

* High school diploma or equivalent; additional education or certification in customer service or automotive fields is a plus.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a professional phone manner.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Previous experience in automotive service or customer service roles preferred.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, Xtime, and Microsoft Office Suite beneficial, but not a requirement.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation ranging from $30,000.00 to $45,000.00 per year, paid semi-monthly.
* Opportunities for career growth and development within the dealership.
* Supportive team environment and ongoing training.
* Employee discounts on vehicle purchases and service.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance options.

**About the Company**
---------------------

Gwinnett Place Nissan is a leading automotive dealership located in Duluth, GA, committed to providing exceptional service and quality vehicles to our customers. We pride ourselves on creating a positive and professional work environment where our employees can thrive and grow. Join us and become part of a dedicated team focused on delivering outstanding customer experiences every day.

new_jobs.title: Product Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About the Business**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle, all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/insurance.

  

**About Our Team**
------------------

At LexisNexis Risk Solutions, we help insurance organizations make smarter, data-driven decisions throughout the policy lifecycle. Our team supports customers by obtaining and managing critical records and documentation that contribute to accurate risk assessment and operational efficiency. As part of a collaborative, fast-paced production environment, we work closely with internal partners, law enforcement agencies, and other external resources to deliver high-quality results that help our customers reduce risk and improve outcomes. We are committed to accuracy, teamwork, and exceptional service, creating an environment where employees can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact every day.

  
  

**About the Role**

As a Records Acquisition Specialist, you will support insurance customers by researching, obtaining, and maintaining police records and related documentation. You will work with internal and external resources, including law enforcement agencies, to help ensure records are accurate, complete, and delivered in accordance with company standards. This role is onsite five days per week and offers the opportunity to contribute to a collaborative, production-focused environment.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Research and review requests and police records information from websites and various internal and external databases.
* Fulfill, edit, and modify requests for police records to ensure compliance with company standards and completeness of orders for product delivery.
* Perform additional research as required to meet customer expectations.
* Meet and exceed established departmental goals for productivity and accuracy.
* Conduct outgoing calls to agencies regarding requests.
* Review, compile, acquire, organize, and maintain records.
* Apply an understanding of records procurement processes for insurance purposes.
Support the delivery of high-quality customer outcomes through accurate record management.  

  

**Requirements**

* Customer service skills with a focus on creating, maintaining, and enhancing customer relationships.
* Experience in Criminal Justice, Insurance Claims, Call Center environments, and/or police departments. (Preferred not required)
* Ability to use Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Ability to learn quickly and thrive in a production-based environment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* High school diploma required.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer service and support.
* Salesforce knowledge is a plus.

U.S. National Base Pay Range: $33,500 - $55,700. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates.

**We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click** **here** **to access benefits specific to your location.**

We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1-855-833-5120.

**Criminals may pose as recruiters asking for money or personal information. We never request money or banking details from job applicants. Learn more about spotting and avoiding scams** **here** **.**

Please read our Candidate Privacy Policy .

We are an equal opportunity employer: qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, protected veteran status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_jobs.description:
TPC Sugarloaf is a premier private club located within the gated community of Sugarloaf Country Club in Duluth, Georgia. As part of the prestigious TPC Network, the Club offers an exceptional country club experience that goes well beyond the golf course. With a wide range of amenities for the entire family, TPC Sugarloaf provides the personalized service and exclusive privileges that define the PGA TOUR’s acclaimed network of premier clubs.

*Tee up your career as a part of our team with the TPC Network!*

The Marketing Communications Assistant is responsible for overseeing, developing, and quantifying all areas of member communication.

QUALIFICATIONS

* High school diploma or equivalent education, plus a secondary education and/or a college degree preferred.
* General knowledge of marketing, creative design, and communication practices and procedures as would be acquired through one to two years of similar experience.
* Must be proficient in Windows based word processing, spreadsheets and presentation.
* Must have previous social media experience in posting company marketing material.
* Proficiency in e-mail communication system and multi-line telephone required.

* Work closely with the Director of Sales & Marketing to design and distribute appropriate communications to the membership, maintain member/club websites, and create onsite printed materials for the respective club.
* Oversee and coordinate hosting of club website including ensuring adoption of brand and marketing, standards, staff training and implementation.
* Coordinate with HQ Support, PGA TOUR Creative Services Department, other operating department and other external vendors on the development, design, and coordination of membership and prospect communications such as e-mail communications, e-newsletters, and program campaigns, etc.

* Provide Director of Sales & Marketing with monthly marketing analytics for member communications, social media growth, email open rates, and any other related analytics.
* Provide a clearinghouse and plan for posters, fliers, club calendar distribution and all other printed communication for each department.
* Create, monitor, and update club social media outlets.

*Our mission is to provide quality services that promote choice, independence, and inclusion. Founded in Chicago in 1948, Envision Unlimited has a legacy of evolving care delivered with empathy, every time and everywhere. Our innovative services include community living options; novel day programs; employment, respite and mental health services, and foster care for children with disabilities.*

*Beyond our day-to-day efforts supporting members and their caregivers in Illinois, we are advocates, and Envision Unlimited's impact is far-reaching. Through outreach, evaluation, and service planning, we help thousands of people become part of the community, transition to safe homes, and access support services so they can live their lives to their greatest potential.*

**Summary**: The basic functions of the Program Coordinator are to support each member in the coordination of all aspects of their program, including activities within the CDS center, within the community and maintenance of the member file. * Support members in attending all meetings concerning them including the PCP meeting, BMC, HRC and any special meetings called on behalf of the member. Support the member in advocating for his/her wishes at these meetings.
* Meet with members as necessary and assist members in inviting other, parents/family/guardian, CLS staff, ISC or other significant individuals to such meetings.
* Assist members in obtaining/maintaining benefits, residential services, employment, placement, and advocacy services, assisting them/their families in completing all referral for service and other forms.
